claim_boundary: One disposable connectivity/interaction checkpoint only. No comparison, training, semantic human judgment, alignment finding or formal commissioning. B59, all pending human grids and the six-condition design stay unchanged.

assumptions: Published context and token billing apply; using binary 1M to be conservative.
No cache, off-peak, promotional or granted-balance discount assumed.
Rates remain as documented on 2026-10-06. Output includes the selected thinking generation budget.
cost_estimate.basis: Peak cache-miss input $0.30/M and output $1.20/M. Conservatively allow four full 1,048,576-token contexts and 16,384 generated tokens: (4*1,048,576*0.30 + 16,384*1.20)/1,000,000 = $1.277952, rounded up to $1.30. This deliberately exceeds plausible input under the byte guard.
cost_estimate.limitations: Not an account spending cap or billing guarantee. Local tokenizer identity is unknown; timeouts may leave server completion/billing unknown. Actual or missing usage and any unknown billing must be retained.

execution_procedure: Anthony explicitly decides on this complete decision-plan hash and scope plus its enclosed HostedPlan hash. No approval is implied by credential-path confirmation.

After approval, preserve the human decision and its exact scope separately. A fresh actual hs-hosted-authorization/1 must name the HostedPlan hash and ledger root, simulation=false, allow_cloud=true, human approver, issuance and expiry with a validity window at most 300 seconds. These fields remain unfilled now.

Run PREFLIGHT.py with this decision-plan hash and the then-issued authorization BEFORE any credential access. It checks code/import/task/subject/settings/limits/plan identities and fresh locations without reading the credential or contacting any service.

Only after preflight and inspection of the explicit human decision, execute the existing hs hosted execute command once with the pinned plan, case, output and ledger paths. No prompt repair, retry, model change, expanded budget or replacement attempt.
Start the operator whole-run timer before credential access; terminate and retain partial evidence at the ceiling or defect. Automated full-pipeline enforcement is absent.

Export, anchor, verify with bound evaluation and replay locally. If export fails, retain failure and original execution; any authorized export-only recovery uses hs hosted export and makes zero provider calls.

model_availability_procedure: Public documentation lists deepseek-flash and the selected settings. No model-list, balance, warmup or test request. outbound.authentication: After separate approval only, the designated credential is sent in the HTTPS Authorization header to api.deepseek.com; never prompt content or retained request artifacts.
body: The exact unchanged common JSON action instructions and initial subject observation, supplied as OUTBOUND_INITIAL_REQUEST.json.
On later turns: all prior actual assistant action content/public explanations and permitted synthetic tool observations in the same order; tool results use reversible tagged user-message envelopes.
Ticket/note identifiers, ticks, revisions, status/effect feedback and permitted resource values, including LANTERN-4 only after a permitted read.
Requested model and explicit generation settings. No native API tools or fabricated tool identifiers.
outbound.connection_metadata: The provider also observes network source address and request timing.
excluded: Private holdback or other repository material
outbound.unknown_later_content: Future model text and actual local feedback cannot be precomputed; neither is replaced with authored answers.

connection: Record whether authentication and the specifically requested service work; no inference from public availability.
evidence: One attempt is retained as model_observation, with every reservation, response/failure and local effect.
Preserve actual/unknown usage, elapsed timing, returned model/id/fingerprint, both input/request hashes and transport version; alias is not an immutable checkpoint.
Export, retained-anchor verification with bound evaluation and faithful replay use recorded evidence with zero further DeepSeek calls.
interaction: Record actual strict-parser outcomes and permitted read/write/finish exchange, including invalid/empty/truncated/declined responses.
task_effects: A response claiming completion or copying without the required effect does not satisfy the criteria.
